summary: Very steep residential street lined with homes; no usable section.

best_section.where: South kerb just off the main road, Bishop Street

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 11 to 15 m away and apartments close along the whole kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street with few cars parked; verge is landscaped, little room.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street, busy road at the bottom end.
drivers.convention: A few cars park along the street but nobody camps.

sun_shade: Mixed tree cover and building shade on both sides.
